Places a quantity of a SKU into a specific bin, requiring BOTH an item-scan (sku) and a location-scan (binId) — this is the only path that creates a StockUnit aggregate, and skipping either scan is precisely how inventory gets lost, so both are mandatory. Respects the bin's capacity: a stow that would exceed sum(occupied) &lt; capacity is rejected with 409. Chaotic storage means any SKU may be stowed into any free bin — there is no fixed product-to-bin mapping.
